Expansion PanelContainment

The `m3e-expansion-panel` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Standalone panels

M3eelbuildHTML
M3e.expansionPanel []
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.header (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ])
, Kit.text "Panel contents"
]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.el { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] } [] [ Kit.text "Panel contents" ]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.build { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withChild (Kit.text "Panel contents")
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.toElement
<m3e-expansion-panel>
<span slot="header">Panel header</span>
Panel contents
</m3e-expansion-panel>

Standalone panels (2)

M3eelbuildHTML
M3e.expansionPanel [ M3e.ExpansionPanel.open True ]
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.header (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ])
, Kit.text "Panel contents"
]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.el { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] } [ M3e.ExpansionPanel.open True ] [ Kit.text "Panel contents" ]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.build { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withOpen True
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withChild (Kit.text "Panel contents")
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.toElement
<m3e-expansion-panel open>
<span slot="header">Panel header</span>
Panel contents
</m3e-expansion-panel>

Toggles

M3eelbuildHTML
M3e.expansionPanel
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.togglePosition M3e.Values.before
, M3e.ExpansionPanel.toggleDirection M3e.Values.horizontal
]
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.header (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ])
, Kit.text "Panel contents"
]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.el { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.togglePosition M3e.Values.before
, M3e.ExpansionPanel.toggleDirection M3e.Values.horizontal
]
[ Kit.text "Panel contents" ]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.build { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withTogglePosition M3e.Values.before
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withToggleDirection M3e.Values.horizontal
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withChild (Kit.text "Panel contents")
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.toElement
<m3e-expansion-panel toggle-position="before" toggle-direction="horizontal">
<span slot="header">Panel header</span>
Panel contents
</m3e-expansion-panel>

Toggles (2)

M3eelbuildHTML
M3e.expansionPanel [ M3e.ExpansionPanel.hideToggle True ]
[ M3e.ExpansionPanel.header (TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ])
, Kit.text "Panel contents"
]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.el { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] } [ M3e.ExpansionPanel.hideToggle True ] [ Kit.text "Panel contents" ]
M3e.ExpansionPanel.build { header = TypedHtml.span [] [ Kit.text "Panel header" ] }
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withHideToggle True
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.withChild (Kit.text "Panel contents")
|> M3e.ExpansionPanel.toElement
<m3e-expansion-panel hide-toggle="">
<span slot="header">Panel header</span>
Panel contents
</m3e-expansion-panel>

{ content =

[]

API

Constructor

view : List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.Is s) admittedBy msg

Standard constructor: [attributes] [children]. The default slot is kind-permissive (any): children of any kind compose, but each child's OWN admittedBy must still admit this context — a restricted-parent element is rejected here at compile time.

type Is

The kind row m3e-expansion-panel produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type ToggleIconSlot

The kinds the toggle-icon slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

type ToggleDirection

The toggleDirection values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

type TogglePosition

The togglePosition values valid on this component (compile-tight narrowing).

Other

el : { header : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg } -> List.List (HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.Attrs msg) -> List.List (HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts (M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> HtmlIr.Element.Element (M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.Is s) admittedBy msg

Required-content (and action) constructor — omissions are unwritable.

toggleDirection : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.ToggleDirection -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | toggleDirection : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The direction of the expansion toggle. (default: "vertical")

togglePosition : HtmlIr.Value.Value M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.TogglePosition -> HtmlIr.Attribute.Attr { c | togglePosition : HtmlIr.Kind.Supported } msg

The position of the expansion toggle. (default: "after")

See M3e.Attributes.disabled.

See M3e.Attributes.hideToggle.

See M3e.Attributes.open.

See M3e.Events.onOpening.

See M3e.Events.onOpened.

See M3e.Events.onClosing.

actions : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named actions slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

header : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named header slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

toggleIcon : HtmlIr.Element.Element M3e.Component.ExpansionPanel.ToggleIconSlot admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place an element into the named toggle-icon slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list).

child : HtmlIr.Element.Element childAccepts admittedBy msg -> HtmlIr.Element.Element free freeAdmittedBy msg

Place a pre-built element into the default (unnamed) slot (input constrained to the slot's kinds; output row free so it composes into the child list). The list-form sibling of the builder's withChild.
